blocks.text: As you use Agentic SOC, you can customize alert scoring by creating new factors or editing existing factors for alerts, MITRE ATT&CK classifications, users, and assets.

blocks.item: Access the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal.
From the top navigation, click Agentic SOC.
In the left-side navigation, go to Settings > Scoring.
The Alert Score page opens.
On the Alert Score page, do one of the following:
Update an Existing Factor
In the Alert section, the MITRE ATT&CK section, the User section, or the Asset section, select an existing factor from the list.
See image.
The detail panel for the alert factor opens.
In the detail panel:
Factor Type: View the factor type, based on whether you are updating a factor for the Alert section, the MITRE ATT&CK section, the User section, or the Asset section.

Field: Select a field from the drop-down menu. The options in the Field change based on whether you are adding a factor for the Alert section, the MITRE ATT&CK section, the User section, or the Asset section. Based on your selection, use the operators and fields to add parameters for the factor.
Factor Name: Specify a unique name for the factor. By default, Agentic SOC uses the value from the Field drop-down menu to populate the Factor Name field.
See image.
Click Apply.
The detail panel for the alert factor closes.
Click Apply.
The updated alert factor appears on the Alert Score page.
Add a New Factor
In the Alert section, the MITRE ATT&CK section, the User section, or the Asset section, click Add Factor.
See image.
The detail panel for the alert factor opens.
In the detail panel:
Factor Type: View the factor type, based on whether you are adding a factor for the Alert section, the MITRE ATT&CK section, the User section, or the Asset section.

Field: Select a field from the drop-down menu. The options in the Field change based on whether you are adding a factor for the Alert section, the MITRE ATT&CK section, the User section, or the Asset section. Based on your selection, use the operators and fields to add parameters for the factor.
Factor Name: Specify a unique name for the factor. By default, Agentic SOC uses the value from the Field drop-down menu to populate the Factor Name field.
See image.
Click Add.
The detail panel for the alert factor closes.
Click Apply.
The new alert factor appears on the Alert Score page.
Click Save to save your changes, or click Save & Process to save your changes and process alert data with the updates.
